mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing the clinic's dispatch history with depot intake was most worthwhile: the matching IDs made it clear how a filter could turn real requests into an apparent zero.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to compare the tape with the volunteer histories was frustrating because the preceding result suggested that comparison, but the board had to be prepared first.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the suggested comparison was unavailable until the volunteer histories had been put on the repaired board.

arbitrary.text: The need to put the histories on the board before comparing them with the tape felt somewhat arbitrary, even though the public display had a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: tracing the records into a correctable public display and seeing Moth revise its conclusion made the discovery engaging.
